issue.title: [HttpParser] Handle invalid/malformed request chunks from client

summary.text: The bug was reproduced: a test fails before the fix and passes after it, and the fix changes how HttpParser.process_line raises exceptions on malformed request lines, a change the Judge labelled as intended. The most important next step is getting the existing suite to run cleanly on the fixed code, because the guard stage was inconclusive and regressions were skipped, so the mutation rate is inc…

survivors.description: Loosens request line check to accept lines with only two parts.
survivors.diff:
--- a/proxy.py
+++ b/proxy.py
@@ -726,3 +726,3 @@
         if self.type == httpParserTypes.REQUEST_PARSER:
-            if len(line) < 3:
+            if len(line) < 2:
                 raise ProtocolException('Invalid request line %r' % raw)
survivors.words: proxy.py:727: changing `            if len(line) < 3:` to `            if len(line) < 2:` made no test fail; no input tried behaved differently from the fix (it may be equivalent)

-        line = raw.split(WHITESPACE)

-            self.version = line[2]

-                raise ProtocolException('Invalid response line %r' % raw)
-            self.version = line[0]

+        return None
survivors.words:
proxy.py:725: changing `        line = raw.split(WHITESPACE)
        if self.type ==...` to `        return None` made no test fail; it behaves differently from the fix on inputs no test checks
